title: Codex on AWS bedrock bug causing 10x charges
summary: A GitHub issue reporting that Codex deployed on AWS Bedrock has a bug causing approximately 10x overcharging, leading to unexpectedly high billing costs for users.
problem_solved: Exposes a critical billing bug in Codex on AWS Bedrock causing users to be overcharged 10x their expected costs
why_valuable: This is a critical financial issue that could result in significant unexpected charges for enterprise users relying on Codex for production workloads
